name: Predator Strix

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You come from a line of strix with exceptionally broad wings and lengthy talons. You gain a talon melee unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage. Your talon attack is in the brawling group and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.
